item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:34 HKT 17/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An active southwesterly airstream will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China today. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve and it will be hot over Guangdong in the next few days. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region.

Date/Month: 17/06 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 25 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
